title: Juicy Pungent Brazilian Vegetables Biryani
description:
A hearty Brazilian-style biryani with pungent flavors and juicy vegetables, perfect for a monsoon evening.
It's a vegetarian-friendly twist on a classic dish.

ingredients.name: Mixed Vegetables (carrots, zucchini, bell peppers, onions)
ingredients.notes: any combination of colorful vegetables works

ingredients.name: Brazilian-Style Biryani Masala
ingredients.notes: use pre-made or make your own blend

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the biryani masala and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and sauté until they start to soften.
Add the grated ginger and green chilies, and continue to cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the basmati rice to the skillet, stirring to combine with the vegetable mixture.
Transfer the contents of the skillet to a large saucepan or Dutch oven, layering the rice and vegetables in a pyramid shape.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan, and cover with a tight-fitting lid.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the biryani with a fork to combine the rice and vegetables, and transfer to a serving dish.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with grilled pineapple chutney on the side.
